plugins.name: wizzo-fleet-presence
plugins.description: Fleet presence for Codex sessions: merges four [[hooks.*]] blocks into <CODEX_HOME>/config.toml that call acsendr's coordctl with --vendor codex, so Codex sessions appear on the Agent Mesh and in Jarvis beside Claude Code ones. Install with `python3 scripts/install-presence-hooks.py` from the pinned repo (idempotent; --check is a dry run). Codex must be invoked with --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust or no hook runs. No secrets: env-var names and op:// references only.
